name: btr-swap-monorepo
author: BTR Supply <contact@btr.supply>
description: Generic Bridge+Swap aggregator for compatible EVMs

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:cli
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.pre-commit: bun run lint:fix && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test:unit
scripts.commit:version: git add . && git commit -m "chore: bump version to v$npm_package_version"
scripts.create:github-tag: git tag -a v$npm_package_version -m "Release v$npm_package_version: @btr-supply/swap and @btr-supply/swap-cli" && git push origin v$npm_package_version
scripts.publish:patch: bun run pre-commit && bun run version:bump:patch && bun run update:changelog && npm publish --workspaces && bun run commit:version && bun run create:github-tag
scripts.publish:minor: bun run pre-commit && bun run version:bump:minor && bun run update:changelog && npm publish --workspaces && bun run commit:version && bun run create:github-tag
scripts.publish:major: bun run pre-commit && bun run version:bump:major && bun run update:changelog && npm publish --workspaces && bun run commit:version && bun run create:github-tag
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run build && bun run install:cli
